factReview: Fits around your specials, lunch, and recess
insideNote: A one-page note for the guest teacher: the day at a glance
insideScript: A script for each of the {n} blocks: what to say, how to start, and what to do when a child is stuck
insidePages: {n} worksheets: one for every block, with a second page for early finishers and an easier page for children who need one
insideForms: A form the guest teacher fills in at the end of the day
insideClass: Class information sheets that you fill in once: class list, schedule, routines, behavior plan, who gets the easier page, and how each child goes home
teacherTitle: The whole day in one file

planNote: The pack, the guest teacher pages, and saved pages are included with the {plan} plan.

pdfHello: Thank you for teaching our class today.
pdfIntro: Everything in this pack is review, so there is nothing new to teach. Each block has one worksheet for everyone and a short script on the next pages. The class information sheets at the back tell you how our day runs.
pdfBefore1: Read the class information sheets at the back of this pack.
pdfBefore2: Find the copied worksheets and put them in stacks in the order of the list below. Each block has a stack for everyone, a few copies of the easier page, and a stack for early finishers. If the copies have not been made, ask the office for help before the children arrive.
pdfBefore3: Write today's schedule on the board, so that the children can see what comes next.
pdfBefore4: Put one copy of the first worksheet on each desk.
pdfBefore5: Look through each worksheet and do its first item yourself, so that you can show it to the class. This pack has no answer key.
pdfAny1: Read the directions at the top of each worksheet aloud before the children start.
pdfAny2: A child who finishes early gets the page for early finishers. After that the child may read a book or draw on the back of the page. If most of the class is done before the block ends, collect the pages and go to the extra-time list on the class information sheets.
pdfAny3: Collect every worksheet at the end of its block and leave the stacks on the teacher's desk.
pdfAny4: First graders need to move. After every block, have the class stand and stretch for a minute before you hand out the next page.
pdfHandOutText: {title}: the page for everyone. Give the easier page to the children listed on the class information sheets, and to any child who cannot get started after your help. Keep the page for early finishers ready.
pdfMorningSay: "Good morning. My name is ___, and I am your teacher today. Your first job is on your desk."
pdfMorningDo: While the children work, take attendance and lunch count.
pdfBell: Stop ten minutes before dismissal. Collect the pages, have the children pack their bags and clean up around their desks, and follow the dismissal list on the class information sheets. Make sure every child leaves the way the list says.
pdfReportLead: Please fill this in at the end of the day and leave it on the desk.
pdfReportNot: What we did not get to
pdfReportHelp: Children who needed extra help, and with what
pdfReportGood: Children who were a great help today
pdfReportNotes: Anything else the teacher should know
pdfClassLead: The classroom teacher fills in these pages once and keeps a copy with the pack.
pdfClassList: Class list and seating chart (attach a copy)
pdfClassAttendance: Attendance and lunch count: how to take them and where to send them
pdfClassSchedule: Our day: times of arrival, recess, lunch, specials, and dismissal
pdfClassRoutines: Routines: attention signal, restroom, pencils, lining up
pdfClassBehavior: Behavior: our class rules, how I reward good choices, what to do when a child does not follow directions
pdfClassEasier: Children who get the easier page: in reading and writing, in math
pdfClassPullouts: Children who leave the room: who, when, and where they go (speech, reading support, English learners, special education)
pdfClassExtra: If there is extra time: a book to read aloud and where it is, a song or game the class knows, where the children read on their own
pdfClassHelpers: Who can help: the teacher next door (name and room), the office (phone extension), children who know the routines
pdfClassNeeds: Children with allergies, medication, a behavior plan, or other needs (see the office or the nurse for details)
pdfClassDismissal: Dismissal: how each child goes home. List the bus riders with bus numbers, the car riders, the walkers, and the children in after-school care
pdfClassEmergency: Emergency procedures: fire drill, lockdown, and severe weather; where the plan and the class list are kept; our way out of the building
